DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis

The combination of progressive fatigue, weakness, and diplopia is highly suggestive of Myasthenia Gravis. To confirm this, I need to review the results of an Acetylcholine Receptor Antibody test and consider a Chest CT to rule out a thymoma.
